independence_requirement: The reviewer must be a person or team member who did not curate or normalize this batch.
review_instructions: Open every official source URL used by the candidate and verify the cited locator supports the benefit, eligibility, exclusion, document, and step claims.
Confirm the policy version is current as of the review date and identify superseded guidance.
Confirm every normalized rule preserves the source meaning and that exclusion predicates are not inverted.
Confirm conditional documents and application steps do not overstate a locally variable process.
Reject any candidate with unavailable evidence, unresolved contradiction, or an inferred eligibility rule not stated by an official source.
Record reviewer identity, review timestamp, per-scheme outcome, findings, and approval signature in a separate immutable review receipt.

scheme_reviews.focus: Check the full higher-economic-status exclusion list, land-record succession treatment, and current eKYC notice.
Check the deprivation-declaration wording, household LPG exclusion, free first refill, and document list.
Do not approve deterministic eligibility unless current post-restructuring onboarding evidence is obtained.
Check age boundaries, savings-account requirement, and the 1 October 2022 income-taxpayer amendment.
Check the unbanked-person condition and ensure overdraft and insurance are described as conditional.
Confirm only PMMVY 2.0 rules are used, including first-child and second-girl-child conditions and exclusions.
Keep entitlement tied to the authoritative current beneficiary database and check later national or State cohort changes.
Check all eighteen trades, family definition, government-service exclusion, and prior-credit exceptions.
Check the ₹3,50,000 annual income unit, school exclusions, mark relaxations, and continuation rules.
Confirm the record is presented as a State/UT-delivered soil-sampling service, not an on-demand cash entitlement.
